Hosted by Okumusashi Hanno Tourism Association

We're holding "Hanno Cherry Blossom Week" at Central Park (formerly called Hanno Spring Festival). The event runs for 9 days from March 28 to April 5, 2026 (Reiwa 8). Food trucks and other vendors will be on site selling food and drinks. Note: There will be no lantern lighting (illumination) this year. Parking is limited, so we recommend using public transportation. There are no trash bins at the venue, so please take your trash with you. The entire venue is non-smoking.

More information: https://hanno-tourism.jp/news/%e9%a3%af%e8%83%bd%e3%81%95%e3%81%8f%e3%82%89%e3%82%a6%e3%82%a3%e3%83%bc%e3%82%af
